changelog:
Initial release – a world-class digital & AI transportation reference system designed for professionals.

- Covers 15 transportation modes, 130+ digital scenarios, 25 AI applications, 140+ vendors, 12 categories, 10 architecture models, and 31 domains, supporting full-stack digital/AI transformation.
- Strict output compliance: all responses must include legal notices, disclaimers, author info, and a value proposition paragraph.
- Ten core "iron rules" set technical, safety, compliance, and methodological standards for all recommendations.
- Provides transparent source/methodology statements for data, benchmarks, and maturity ratings.
- Includes quick navigation, role-based guidance, usage modes, and essential questions for project kick-off.
- For personal study only; strictly prohibits commercial use without author authorization.
